The structure of V7Co2B2 (reduced formula V7CoB) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows B centers with 10 neighbors (5 Co, 5 V), Co centers with 14 neighbors (2 B, 10 V), and two distinct V environments: one with 14 neighbors (6 B, 8 Co) and another with 10 neighbors (4 B, 6 Co). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among B, Co, and V coordination polyhedra.
